# Shared machines
<!-- Generated by tooling/generate-agent-context.py from tooling/agent-context/sites/jlab-ifarm.yaml in eic/skills. Manual changes will be lost. -->

- `ifarm.jlab.org` is a login node shared with other users: for editing, light tests
  and job submission. **Do NOT** run an analysis over a large dataset there; submit it
  as a batch job with a time limit, after testing on one file.
- Batch system: Slurm. Submit with `sbatch`, check with
  `squeue --me`, cancel your own jobs with `scancel`; set `--time` and the EIC account.
- Home: not recorded here, run `echo $HOME`.
  Scratch for large outputs: /volatile/eic (auto-cleaned by a deletion policy).
- **Do NOT** leave background processes behind on a login node.
